description.en: Authentic bar culture, ordering at trattorias, pasta, wine, and dining etiquette.
description.zh-CN: 地道意式咖啡吧文化、餐馆点餐、经典面食披萨、葡萄酒及结账必备。

translations.zh-CN: 一杯浓缩咖啡 (意式默认单份)

pronunciationNotes.en: In Italy, asking for 'un caffè' always gets you a single shot of espresso. Double 'ff' is stressed.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 在意大利只说'un caffè'默认就是一杯浓缩espresso。双写ff需加重。

exampleSentence.it: Buongiorno, un caffè al banco, per favore.
exampleSentence.en: Good morning, an espresso at the bar counter, please.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 早上好，请在吧台给我来一杯意式浓缩。

pronunciationNotes.en: Italians only drink cappuccino for breakfast, never after lunch or dinner. Double 'pp' and 'cc' are held.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 意大利人通常只在早餐喝卡布奇诺，餐后喝会被视为异类。'cc'读拼音q。

exampleSentence.it: Prendo un cappuccino e un cornetto alla crema.
exampleSentence.en: I'll take a cappuccino and a cream croissant.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我要一杯卡布奇诺和一个奶油羊角包。

translations.zh-CN: 意式羊角可颂 (早餐常吃)

pronunciationNotes.en: Double 'tt' requires a crisp momentary stop before releasing the 'o'.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 双写tt需要短暂停顿闭气再发出to音，t不送气。

exampleSentence.it: Un cornetto vuoto o con la marmellata?
exampleSentence.en: A plain croissant or with jam?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 要原味羊角包还是加果酱的？

pronunciationNotes.en: 'z' before 'io' is pronounced /tts/. 'Fare colazione' means to have breakfast.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 'zi'读作/ts/，意语常用搭配'fare colazione'表示吃早餐。

exampleSentence.it: Facciamo colazione al bar dell'angolo.
exampleSentence.en: Let's have breakfast at the corner bar.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我们去街角的咖啡吧吃早餐吧。

pronunciationNotes.en: 'z' is voiced /dz/. Lunch is the main traditional meal in Italy around 13:00.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 'z'发浊音/dz/，意大利正统午餐通常在下午一点左右。

exampleSentence.it: Cosa prepari oggi per pranzo?
exampleSentence.en: What are you making for lunch today?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 你今天午饭准备做什么？

pronunciationNotes.en: 'Ce' sounds like 'che' (/tʃe/). Dinner in Italy is typically eaten after 20:00.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 'ce'读音如拼音'qei'，意大利晚餐时间通常在晚上8点以后。

exampleSentence.it: A che ora è pronta la cena?
exampleSentence.en: What time will dinner be ready?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 晚饭几点能做好？

pronunciationNotes.en: Grave accent on 'ù' forces the stress onto the final syllable.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 末尾带有重音符号'ù'，重音必须落在最后一个音节。

exampleSentence.it: Possiamo avere il menù, per favore?
exampleSentence.en: Can we have the menu, please?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 能给我们看一下菜单吗，谢谢？

pronunciationNotes.en: Literally 'before the meal' (pasto). T is crisp and unaspirated.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 字面意思为'餐前'，包括火腿拼盘、烤面包丁等。t不送气。

exampleSentence.it: Come antipasto prendiamo un tagliere di salumi.
exampleSentence.en: As an appetizer, we'll take a cold cuts platter.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 开胃前菜我们要一份意式腌肉冷盘。

translations.zh-CN: 第一道正餐 (主食类：意面、烩饭等)

pronunciationNotes.en: Light trill on 'pr'. In Italy, pasta is a first course, not a side dish.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 意大利餐中面条和烩饭是第一道主菜，不是配菜。pr带轻微颤音。

exampleSentence.it: Di primo vorrei gli spaghetti alla carbonara.
exampleSentence.en: For the first course, I would like the carbonara spaghetti.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 第一道菜我想要卡波纳拉培根蛋酱意面。

translations.zh-CN: 第二道主菜 (荤菜类：肉排、海鲜等)

pronunciationNotes.en: Stress on 'con'. Usually served with a side dish (contorno).
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 重音在'con'上，一般为肉类或鱼类，不带主食。

exampleSentence.it: Per secondo prendo la bistecca ai ferri.
exampleSentence.en: For the main course, I'll take the grilled steak.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 第二道主菜我点一份烤牛排。

translations.zh-CN: 配菜 (蔬菜、烤土豆或沙拉)

pronunciationNotes.en: Must be ordered separately from the 'secondo'.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 在意大利餐厅中配菜需单点，不会自动随主菜附送。

exampleSentence.it: Come contorno vorrei le patate al forno.
exampleSentence.en: As a side dish, I would like roast potatoes.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 配菜我想要烤土豆。

pronunciationNotes.en: 'ce' sounds like 'che' (/tʃe/). Dark 'l' before consonant.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 'ce'发拼音qei，结尾甜点必不可少。

exampleSentence.it: Desiderate un dolce della casa o della frutta?
exampleSentence.en: Would you like a homemade dessert or fruit?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 您想要一份本店特色甜点还是水果？

pronunciationNotes.en: Waiters will never bring the bill automatically until you ask for it.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 在意大利服务员绝不会主动催买单，顾客必须主动示意'il conto'。

exampleSentence.it: Scusi, ci porta il conto quando può?
exampleSentence.en: Excuse me, could you bring us the bill when you can?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 打扰一下，方便时能给我们拿一下账单吗？

translations.zh-CN: 餐位费 / 面包台费 (意大利特色)

pronunciationNotes.en: Standard fixed fee per person in Italian restaurants covering table setting and bread.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 意大利餐厅的固定人头费，涵盖餐具摆设和面包。

exampleSentence.it: Il coperto costa due euro a persona.
exampleSentence.en: The cover charge is two euros per person.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 餐位费是每人两欧元。

pronunciationNotes.en: Double 'zz' is sharp /tts/. Never pronounced with a soft English /z/.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 双写zz发清脆的/ts/音，切勿发成英语的浊音z。

exampleSentence.it: Stasera andiamo a mangiare una pizza margherita.
exampleSentence.en: Tonight we're going to eat a Margherita pizza.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 今晚我们去吃玛格丽特披萨。

pronunciationNotes.en: Pure 'a' vowels. P and T are unaspirated stops.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 元音a发音饱满，p和t均不送气。

exampleSentence.it: La pasta deve essere cotta al dente.
exampleSentence.en: Pasta must be cooked al dente (firm to the bite).
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 意面一定要煮得'al dente'(弹牙有嚼劲)。

pronunciationNotes.en: 's' between vowels is voiced /z/. Double 'tt' is held.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: s在元音间发浊音z，双写tt停顿，典型的意北特色饭。

exampleSentence.it: Un risotto ai funghi porcini, squisito!
exampleSentence.en: A porcini mushroom risotto, delicious!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 一份牛肝菌烩饭，太美味了！

pronunciationNotes.en: 'V' requires teeth on bottom lip. Double 'ss' in 'rosso' is crisp.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: v咬唇发音，'rosso'中r轻颤，双写ss加重。

exampleSentence.it: Vorremmo un calice di vino rosso della casa.
exampleSentence.en: We would like a glass of house red wine.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我们想要一杯本店自酿的红葡萄酒。

pronunciationNotes.en: 'Bianco' has a clear /bjaŋ/ diphthong and nasalized n before k.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 'bianco'中的ian为双元音，k发音干脆。

exampleSentence.it: Il pesce si abbina bene con il vino bianco.
exampleSentence.en: Fish pairs well with white wine.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 鱼类和白葡萄酒很相配。

pronunciationNotes.en: Strong double 'rr' trill. Crucial practice word for Italian rolled R.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 双写rr必须有明显的舌尖大舌颤音，练习颤音的绝佳词汇。

exampleSentence.it: Una birra alla spina media, grazie.
exampleSentence.en: A medium draft beer, please.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 请给我来一杯中杯生啤酒。

pronunciationNotes.en: Grave accent on 'è'. Unaspirated 't', open 'e' sound.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 开口e，t不送气，与英文tea发音不同。

exampleSentence.it: Preferisci un tè al limone o alla pesca?
exampleSentence.en: Do you prefer lemon or peach iced tea?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 你想要柠檬茶还是桃子冰茶？

pronunciationNotes.en: 'Ge' sounds like 'je' (/dʒe/). World-famous Italian treat.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 'ge'发拼音je音，重音在'la'，口感绵密浓郁。

exampleSentence.it: Prendiamo un gelato con due gusti: pistacchio e cioccolato.
exampleSentence.en: Let's get a two-scoop gelato: pistachio and chocolate.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我们来一个双拼冰淇淋：开心果加巧克力味。

pronunciationNotes.en: Literally means 'pick me up' (cheer me up). Stress firmly on the final 'ù'.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 字面意思为'带我走'或'让我振作起来'。重音在末尾ù。

exampleSentence.it: Il tiramisù di questa trattoria è favoloso.
exampleSentence.en: The tiramisu in this trattoria is fabulous.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 这家餐馆的提拉米苏简直绝了。

pronunciationNotes.en: Double 'gg' before 'io' sounds like strong /ddʒ/. Stress on 'ma'.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 双写gg发强硬的浊音/ddʒ/，如帕玛森干酪Parmigiano。

exampleSentence.it: Vuoi un po' di formaggio grattugiato sulla pasta?
exampleSentence.en: Do you want some grated cheese on your pasta?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 你想在面条上撒一点奶酪粉吗？

pronunciationNotes.en: 'sc' before 'i' makes a /ʃ/ ('sh') sound. Double 'tt' is held.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 'sci'发类似拼音sh的音，'prosciutto crudo'是著名帕尔马生火腿。

exampleSentence.it: Prendo un panino con prosciutto crudo e mozzarella.
exampleSentence.en: I'll have a sandwich with prosciutto crudo and mozzarella.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我要一个加生火腿和马苏里拉奶酪的帕尼尼。

pronunciationNotes.en: Apostrophe elides 'di oliva' into smooth 'd'oliva'.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: di与oliva省音缩写为d'oliva，地中海饮食灵魂。

exampleSentence.it: Condisci l'insalata con olio extravergine d'oliva.
exampleSentence.en: Dress the salad with extra-virgin olive oil.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 用特级初榨橄榄油拌一下沙拉。

pronunciationNotes.en: Two syllables: sa-le. Clear open 'a' and closed 'e'.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 两个音节，不要念成单音节。sa-le。

exampleSentence.it: Manca un pizzico di sale nel sugo.
exampleSentence.en: The sauce is missing a pinch of salt.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 酱汁里少了一撮盐。

pronunciationNotes.en: 'cch' sounds like hard double /kk/. Stress on first syllable 'zuc'.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 'cch'发双硬辅音kk，重音在第一个音节zuc上。

exampleSentence.it: Bevi il caffè con o senza zucchero?
exampleSentence.en: Do you drink coffee with or without sugar?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 你喝咖啡加糖还是不加糖？

pronunciationNotes.en: 'ch' is hard /k/. Double 'tt' is stressed.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 'che'发ke音，双写tt停顿，不送气。

exampleSentence.it: Mi è caduta la forchetta, me ne porta un'altra?
exampleSentence.en: I dropped my fork, could you bring me another?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我的叉子掉了，能帮我换一把吗？

pronunciationNotes.en: Double 'll' is held against the roof of the mouth.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 双写ll舌尖抵住上颚延长，t不送气。

exampleSentence.it: Questo coltello non taglia molto bene.
exampleSentence.en: This knife doesn't cut very well.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 这把餐刀切不太动。

pronunciationNotes.en: Double 'cch' gives a crisp double /kk/ stop before the tripthong /jajo/.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 'cch'双辅音发硬音k，后续多个元音流畅滑过。

exampleSentence.it: Usa il cucchiaio per la minestra.
exampleSentence.en: Use the spoon for the soup.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 喝热汤用勺子。

pronunciationNotes.en: Double 'cch' is hard /kk/. Stress on 'e'.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 'cch'发硬辅音k，重音在'e'上。

exampleSentence.it: Posso avere un bicchiere d'acqua naturale?
exampleSentence.en: May I have a glass of still water?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 能给我一杯不带气的常温水吗？

pronunciationNotes.en: 'gli' produces the palatal lateral sound /ʎ/ (similar to 'million'). Double 'tt'.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 'gli'发舌侧音/ʎ/，舌面紧贴硬腭，类似汉语拼音'li+y'。

exampleSentence.it: Prendiamo una bottiglia d'acqua frizzante.
exampleSentence.en: Let's get a bottle of sparkling water.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我们来一瓶含气矿泉水。

translations.zh-CN: 热的 / 烫的 / 温暖的

pronunciationNotes.en: Pure 'a'. Don't confuse with Spanish 'caldo' (broth); here it's an adjective for temperature.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 形容温度高。注意咖啡要喝热的用'caldo'。

exampleSentence.it: Attento, il piatto è molto caldo!
exampleSentence.en: Careful, the plate is very hot!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 小心，盘子非常烫！

translations.zh-CN: 冷的 / 凉的 / 冰的

pronunciationNotes.en: Double 'dd' gives weight to the second syllable.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 双写dd加重闭音，r带颤音。

exampleSentence.it: In estate mi piace bere il tè freddo.
exampleSentence.en: In summer I like to drink iced tea.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 夏天我喜欢喝冰茶。

translations.zh-CN: 好吃的 / 美味的 / 好的

pronunciationNotes.en: Standard compliment for food. Say 'È buonissimo!' for 'It's delicious!'
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 夸赞食物好吃的最常用词，'È buonissimo!'表示太好吃了！

exampleSentence.it: Questo risotto è veramente buono!
exampleSentence.en: This risotto is really good!
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 这盘意式烩饭真好吃！

translations.zh-CN: 无麸质 (意大利用餐常见标志)

pronunciationNotes.en: 'Senza' has /ts/ for 'z'. Crucial dietary phrase widely accommodated in Italy.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 意大利对麸质过敏极为友好，几乎所有餐厅均提供无麸质选项。

exampleSentence.it: Avete della pasta o pizza senza glutine?
exampleSentence.en: Do you have gluten-free pasta or pizza?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 请问有无麸质的意面或披萨吗？

translations.zh-CN: 我想点餐... / 我想点一个...

pronunciationNotes.en: Polite conditional form of 'volere'. Double 'rr' in 'vorrei'.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 点餐最礼貌地道的句式，比'voglio'温和客气很多。

exampleSentence.it: Vorrei ordinare una pizza quattro formaggi.
exampleSentence.en: I would like to order a four-cheese pizza.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我想点一份四重奶酪披萨。

pronunciationNotes.en: Standard phrase at pizzerias, bars, and fast food counters.
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 打包带走必备短语，买咖啡、披萨外带时告知店家。

exampleSentence.it: Due tranci di pizza margherita da portare via, grazie.
exampleSentence.en: Two slices of Margherita pizza to go, thanks.
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 两角玛格丽特披萨打包带走，谢谢。

pronunciationNotes.en: Italian businesses are legally required to accept cards (POS).
pronunciationNotes.zh-CN: 意大利强制普及POS刷卡，买单时询问刷卡必备句子。

exampleSentence.it: Non ho contanti, posso pagare con carta?
exampleSentence.en: I don't have cash, can I pay by card?
exampleSentence.zh-CN: 我没带现金，可以刷卡吗？
